name: pathmode
description: Run a deterministic preflight on your intent before an agent builds: /preflight scores six calibrated gates and names the exact blockers, no model call, no key. Pathmode also interrogates the intent behind a request (compile-intent), writes it to intent.md in your repo, and checks the code that comes back against the outcomes and constraints you agreed to. Free: uses the models you already have access to in Claude Code. Connect a Pathmode workspace to sync intent and evidence across a team.

api_key.title: Pathmode API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave empty to run in keyless local mode (specs live in intent.md in your repo). To sync with a Pathmode workspace, create a key at https://pathmode.io/settings (starts with pm_live_).
